title: A Busy Weekend
text:
Last weekend was very busy for Zeynep. On Saturday morning she got up early and went to the market with her grandmother. They bought fresh tomatoes, cheese and some fruit. After that, they went home and made breakfast together.

In the afternoon Zeynep met her friends in the park. They played volleyball for two hours, and then they ate ice cream because it was very hot. In the evening she was tired, so she watched a film at home and went to bed at ten.

On Sunday it rained all day. Zeynep stayed at home and did her homework. She also called her cousin in Germany. They usually talk once a week, but this time they talked for an hour because her cousin had a lot of news. Zeynep enjoyed her weekend, but on Monday morning she was still a little tired.

ex: I have some good news! (✗ a news)
